page_title: StoryRoute — AI Audio Tour & Historical Stories

sources.entry: StoryRoute - AI-powered GPS audio tour guide that generates real-time location-aware travel narratives as you explore cities. Free to use.

summary.name: StoryRoute
summary.one_liner: StoryRoute is a web app that generates AI audio stories about the history and people of landmarks near your location as you walk.
use_cases: Learning the history of landmarks while walking a city
Hearing stories automatically as you explore a neighbourhood
Self-guided sightseeing without a human guide
Asking questions about nearby places via an AI chat
Planning a route with stops along the way
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI-powered audio tour that generates stories about the history and people of places around the user. It uses the device's location, so the user is asked to allow location access, and it detects the current area and shows route stops. Stories are said to play automatically as the user explores. The page also lists voice narration and an AI chat feature called "Ask StoryRoute", which it says is powered by Groq. The listing describes it as free to use, while the page itself mentions an upgrade offer for unlimited access.
notable: Stories play automatically based on GPS location as you walk
AI chat feature 'Ask StoryRoute' powered by Groq
caveats: Pro upgrade needed for unlimited daily stories and all travel modes
Requires allowing location access in the browser
Page does not describe the story sources or accuracy of AI-generated history
